via.name: Roys Peak photo viewpoints
via.quote: The famous Roys Peak photo viewpoints are roughly 30 minutes before the summit.

evidence: The track starts at Roys Peak car park, on Wānaka – Mount Aspiring Road.
Roys Peak Track ends at the summit of Roys Peak, at 1,578 metres elevation.
From the summit, return back the way you came.

access_points.name: Wānaka (walk or cycle to the Roys Peak Track entrance)
access_points.quote: You can walk or cycle to the Roys Peak Track entrance from Wānaka, using Waterfall Creek Track, Glendhu Bay Track and a section of road.

not_on_route.quote: continue onto the more challenging Skyline Track

not_on_route.name: Isthmus Peak Track
not_on_route.quote: Isthmus Peak Track is an excellent alternative

doubts: Shape out_and_back from DOC's '16 km return via same track' and 'return back the way you came'. The start ref F1 is the road end where the track meets Wānaka – Mount Aspiring Road (the car park). The walk-in from Wānaka uses tracks not managed by DOC and is recorded as an access point. The Skyline Track continuation is an option for experienced trampers, not a way of its own, so it is not_on_route.
